'''TIE Squadron Four''' was a squadron of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].

As part of his [[Thrawn's confederation|confederation]], they fought at [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]] during the [[Battle of Sluis Van|battle]] that took place there. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] ordered them to engage a group of [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]].
